claim: the parent, unchanged -- the coupled patterning+deformation recipe, the control
rationale: control -- Okuda's coupling recipe should reproduce tubulation/branching (Figs 5-7)

claim: without morphogen-driven growth the sheet stays a vesicle and cannot protrude
rationale: growth is the volume source; the paper's coupling needs it. Foundational necessity cell for the map. REFUTED if protr_peak >= 2.0

claim: without T1 remodeling the monolayer cannot deeply invaginate, so tubes/branches are suppressed
rationale: T1 transitions are the topological remodeling that permits deep tubulation/branching; genuinely uncertain whether it fires at this scale

claim: removing morphogen diffusion collapses the spatial pattern, so deformation loses its template and discrete tubes vanish
rationale: Okuda's morphology follows the patterning; tests whether the diffusion half of RD is what localizes protrusions

claim: cell division is NOT necessary -- growth plus sheet mechanics carry the morphology on their own
rationale: breaks the assumption that division realizes the deformation; a call I could easily be wrong about. REFUTED if protr_peak < 1.5

claim: adding uniform inflation on top of the patterned recipe swamps the local protrusions, lowering peak protrusion
rationale: combination Okuda had no reason to try; unpatterned growth competes with the pattern (should push mech_p_ratio toward ~1). REFUTED if protr_peak >= 2.0
